topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes, learning objectives, and the framework for understanding cancer as an evolutionary process influenced by mutations and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stemness in Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties determine cellular susceptibility to oncogenic transformation.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment and Inflammation in Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with cellular mutations to permit tumor outgrowth and maintenance.

topics.label: Methods for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes sequencing and spatial profiling techniques used to map mutations, cellular interactions, and transcriptional states within tumors.

topics.label: Summary of Multi-Factorial Tumor Evolution and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize how intrinsic cell properties, mutational burden, and extrinsic microenvironments converge during cancer evolution and conclude the lecture.
